reviews.author: Rhonda Brown
reviews.text: They are truly the best in town. I visited from Florida, and I trust them completely, they're always honest and straightforward. I’m confident they spent more time working on my vehicle than what they charged me for, and I genuinely appreciate that level of care. Michael’s advice showed he was looking out for my best interests. I believe this is a family-owned business, and this was my second visit; both times, they went above and beyond to help me out.

reviews.author: Name
reviews.text: These guys are top level. The quick communication, fast response and professionalism cannot be matched! The driver had my Nissan Armada loaded and ready to go in under 5 minutes, without missing a beat. This man was on it and had the car dropped at the shop and the keys secured before I could even get there! I was impressed. Would highly recommend this company. Zero complaints.

reviews.author: DBJ SURVEYOR
reviews.text: Great company!! Needed a tow while returning from vacation @ beach. They came to Wadesboro NC picked up my vehicle and delivered to Statesville! Romeo is a PRO!! THANK YOU!! Highly Recommend these guys!

reviews.author: Erika Mosher
reviews.text: We needed a tow truck quickly. I called and the gentleman on the phone said in about an hour. They were spot on and whenever Romeo showed up he showed So much compassion to my sister. He didn't rush her at all and put the vehicle where she needed it to be. Highly recommend this company and forever grateful for his humble demonor today

reviews.author: Sammie Watson
reviews.text: Amazing service. Romeo was awesome quick and efficient. They told me they’d be there within the hour to tow it and they got there in less than 30 minutes. 10/10 would recommend

reviews.author: Rudolph Baker
reviews.text: I’ve had my vehicles worked on here several times. They always fix it right the first time, great communications throughout. I’d rather take it here than the dealership. Owners honest and straightforward. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: renee medlin
reviews.text: Excellent service. Romeo was the driver that we spoke with. Yes, we spoke directly to the driver. No middle man, or call center. Romeo was professional, experienced, and very kind. We were on the side of the interstate and he was quick to respond. Pricing was fair and in a vulnerable position he could have took advantage of the situation. Definitely would recommend him. Excellent service.

reviews.author: Dee L
reviews.text: We were in a bad place. On the shoulder of a State highway in the dark with a flat tire. J&J driver, Romeo Gamarra, was there very quickly and towed us to his shop and helped us change the tire. What a nice guy. Very professional and knowledgeable. Had us back on the road in no time!! Big Kudos.

reviews.author: Lindsay Shaw
reviews.text: We have a Ford dually that we needed fixed quickly, as it's our daily business vehicle. We have always used our local Ford Dealership for service, but after 2 terrible experiences this year, we asked for recommendations for a diesel mechanic and were referred to J and J... What a wonderful experience! Absolutely worth the drive from Huntersville. Our truck was ready for us in less than 24 hours, and for what I can assume is a fraction of what the dealership would have charged. We were so pleased with our experience and will absolutely recommend them and use them again in the future. Lindsay Shaw

reviews.author: Shontia Stokes
reviews.text: They helped me get my car down the mountain when nobody else would answer me. I thank them so much..

reviews.author: Dakota Lineberger
reviews.text: I run a small car lot and have used them for years. They have done my towing and repairs from a tire patch all the way up to motor swaps with pretty much anything in between. I’ve always been happy with their work and they don’t try to upsell you on a bunch of stuff you don’t need.

reviews.author: Brady3mvp
reviews.text: These people are outstanding. From Michael answering the phone to Romeo the one and only tow guy. He is amazing and cool guy. Thanks for towing my Tundra to Toyota. Very professionally down. I would recommend them to anyone that needs a towing.

reviews.author: Karl Is-Karl
reviews.text: Needed a tow the other day and these guys are super friendly and professional. If you need a tow, this is the place to call.

reviews.author: Stacy Dasher
reviews.text: We've used J&J for years now and they are top notch. We trust them and they don't recommend unnecessary work or over charge. Highly recommend for both towing and mechanic work.

reviews.author: Eliajah Santiago
reviews.text: Terrible service, unprofessional. I called for an update the owners son started cussing and hung up on me. They have my work truck for over a year. I payed 2000 dollars in advance. To this day they have not repaired my truck. They need to repair my truck or return it. I also emailed them and have not received a response. Their excuse is that they are understaffed or sometimes they say they are waiting on parts. Good towing but terrible mechanics, terrible customer service.

reviews.author: Megan Zugg
reviews.text: They helped me when I was in a bind. I traveled from MS to here so I could care for my disabled grandparents. My car died on me out of the blue. I was able to jump it off and bring it over to them. They replaced the battery and cleared some other issues I had with my system without me even asking. It was really appreciated!! Best price I could find in town and they were quick with it. Next time I visit and I have issues, I'll be back! Thank you guys again for helping me out.

reviews.author: Ed Naumann
reviews.text: I just had our 2019 corvette towed to shop and Romeo treated it like his car. Fair and reasonable price would use them again or refer them to anyone in need.

reviews.author: Chris Cantrell
reviews.text: Our Highlander encountered a hybrid problem in Durham. Not long after leaving Durham for Asheville, the vehicle died just east of Statesville at about 3pm. Upon reaching out to my insurance company USAA for roadside assistance, they informed me that the soonest they could get a tow vehicle there was the next morning, and they weren’t actually sure they could find a tow company to even do that. I performed an internet search for Statesville Tow Company, and J and J Towing was the first to come up. I called J and J, and they immediately told me they could be there in 45 minutes to an hour. So much for USAA. My wife and I got into our other rental vehicle and continued our tip on to Asheville so we could make our friend’s birthday party on time. Romeo was on the job immediately. After it became apparent that we mistakenly gave him an inaccurate description of the Highlander’s location, though, he proceeded to go out of his way and drive the interstate until he found it. He ended up not charging us extra for this. He then towed our Highlander over the mountains to Northeast Tennessee where we live, and dropped our vehicle off at our house. USAA informed us that a tow to our house would cost $1,500, of which $700 we would be responsible for. Romeo did the entire job much, much sooner for just over $600 total. He had an outstanding attitude the entire time we interacted with him. Upon finding out that he would have to tow to Northeast Tennessee, instead of complaining about the extra work, he asked his family if they would like to ride with him for an impromptu visit to the Tennessee Tri-Cities. Great attitudes make short work of tough jobs! We highly recommend him to anyone in need of a tow in his area. Thank you, Romeo!

reviews.author: Paul Mejia
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience at J & J Towing. I walked in around noon without calling for a possible water pump failure. They told me it wouldn't be an issue to drop it off and I was expecting a few days wait time. Come around 4:30 pm the SAME DAY they called me and told me it was ready! Quick service combined with very friendly employees made my experience great. The guy at the counter even chatted about my car and he offered tons of information about the water pump.

reviews.author: Stacy Everett
reviews.text: Romeo was quick and helpful in getting my vehicle towed from the shoulder of I77. Price was fair and he was great at connecting me to a tire shop.

reviews.author: CHRIS MITCHELL
reviews.text: The guys at J&J are phenomenal. I had a truck stuck in a ditch and they were prompt,efficient and very professional. I highly recommend J&J towing

reviews.author: James Ridgely
reviews.text: Me and my wife Melanie has been very happy with j&j towing and repair. We have never had any issues with them and they are up front with us.

reviews.author: matt loftin
reviews.text: warning warning caution!! took my truck to J&J Towing to be repaired. They said it needed a $4000 Turbo I trusted them that did not fix the problem. They were not willing to work with me on the labor. I fixed the truck myself. It ended up being a bug stuck in the pressure switch. $100 Part, they will not answer my emails or phone calls. I don't think they know what they're doing as far as diesel motors. They had my truck for 22 days.

reviews.author: Haitian Sensation
reviews.text: Would give zero starts if I could. Car sat there for a month. Gave me false hope by saying they could look at it after I towed it from another mechanic. Every week it was a new excuse. They never looked at my car. Car has been sitting there for so long cobwebs began to spread underneath car. Honesty goes along way. If there were good people they would have paid to tow It back to my house considering the fact they never looked at it. Will not being doing business with them in the future. Unless you like unreliability, dishonestly, excuses, people who don’t put you first and have months to wait, this is your place. I’m disappointed in this place expected better.

reviews.author: Megan Connor
reviews.text: Romeo was quick to help tow our car from point A to B! Very good rates, communication, and awesome to work with!

reviews.author: Boots Yak
reviews.text: I broke down 2 miles from the Statesville exit with my van and kayak trailer with kayaks Called them and they came got my van and kayaks. Towed me back to the shop and spent the day getting my van running. They quoted me a price after looking at my van. They did a bunch more to my van to get it running. Put a lot of time and parts that was not on the quote. However when I went to pay the price was just what they quoted me. They stayed after hours to make sure the job was done right. Great people great job my van got me and my kayaks home to Fl and is still running fine. Thank you and take care of that loveable dog!!!!!!.

reviews.author: Cota Walls
reviews.text: HIGHLY RECOMMEND! BEST place in Statesville and they treat you like family! I wouldn’t take my cars anywhere else! I’ve been using J&J Automotive & Towing for all my auto needs for years and they do not disappoint. From simple jobs like oil changes and tire rotations to major jobs like timing belts, they have always taken excellent care of my cars without ripping me off or taking advantage of me or my wallet. They are up front, honest and easy to communicate with regardjng your repair, extremely easy to work with and it is obvious they are highly experienced in both auto repairs and towing! Each time you visit J&J you can expect to see the same friendly faces who you will get to know as you become part of the J&J family. Scott and Michael are great to work with and all of their Mechanics are highly experienced. Robert and Jojo are two of the best two truck drivers around and you can depend on them 24/7 to help if you ever find yourself in a situation where you need a tow, no matter if it’s day or night.

reviews.author: Nathan Born
reviews.text: The team at J&J are great. Honest, thorough, and really knowledgeable. They brought my Chevy Equinox back to life and earned my lifelong business along the way. Thank you team!

reviews.author: Broc LaPointe
reviews.text: I had a medium duty truck towed and the price was literally half of what five other tow services in the area was quoting me. Brandon was excellent very professional very knowledgeable skilled driver. I would highly recommend this company

reviews.author: andy russell
reviews.text: Top grade and professional and they will not leave you setting no longer than they have to unlike AAA waited for AAA for 3 hrs called j&j and they were there loading me up on the wreaker in 45 minutes. Couldn't ask for better service.

reviews.author: Derek Most
reviews.text: I take all of our work fleet here. Honest work and good diagnosing at a fair price. I have full confidence taking vehicles here. 10/10 would recommend.

reviews.author: Zachary Bridges
reviews.text: This is by far the best towing company ive had a to use. Its never a good day when you have to call a tow truck but making the call to these guys made my day turn out a lot better than it wouldve. I will always use J&J in the future

reviews.author: Renee Stuart
reviews.text: Quick response time, great communication, very helpful finding a dealership for my repair. Driver was very kind. Thank you very much for top notch service!

reviews.author: jim hodge
reviews.text: Today my 16 ft. Box truck broke down on I40 in Statesville and I needed it towed to Charlotte, I called 2 other tow companies but they didn't tow outside of Iredell County. They both suggested J&J Towing. They showed in in 25 minutes and got my truck to the shop in Charlotte. Thank you J&J Towing. Great job !!

reviews.author: Shawn Parks
reviews.text: Great folks. Provided us with prompt towing and got repairs done right away to get us back on the road. If I needed repairs when traveling near the Statesville area again, they would certainly be my first and only choice.

reviews.author: David Martin
reviews.text: They just showed up to tow us and then said they had to leave to attend to another call and left us stranded. Wife with a broken foot and in the hot sun. I begged them to tow us and the driver said it was his bosses fault. Well, Steve Barnes is on the way. I recommend Barnes towing any day.

reviews.author: Tina Cox
reviews.text: Had my daughter van towed to J&J after another place put the motor in bcause it would not cranck asked them to hook it up to the computer to see if there was anything they could see was wrong with motor, after two days of calling and no phone call returned I finally got someone on the phone. He was telling me that he really didnt know what was wrong with it but that the motor sensors or he flywheel would be his guess. After direction from my Dad they looked at it again and gave my Dad a report that the used mototr that I had just installed would enternally bad and it would take hours of intesnse labor to find the final problem. So I talked to the guys I bought the motor from and they told me the samething probably was the flky wheel, so I took the car back to the first shop and he agreed to look at it and make it right. After changing the motor sensors he noticed that the cadalic converter was busted and that there was a box unhooked he hooked it up and the van cranked. So J&J pulled computer parts off and did return them busted the cadalic conveter and took the overflow jug out and didnt put it back and provided a report to my dad saying the motor was bad and they would tear into it to decide to whast the problems were. My Dad got upset and tried going and talking to them in which they called the cops on him. Now keep in mind he is 83 years old!!!!! Will never use them again.

reviews.author: Zack Mccants
reviews.text: J and J towing is by far an excellent choice. Real Professional. My task wasn’t a easy one but these guys surpassed my expectations

reviews.author: Bryan Thornton
reviews.text: Very professional. Great response time. Reasonable rates. Their driver operator very personable courteous and knows what he is doing.

reviews.author: Teaj
reviews.text: J and J Towing, Romeo was fast, communicative, efficient, helpful and understanding. I am grateful to have been helped by this company. Thanks again.

reviews.author: todd goodman
reviews.text: The guys here did a great job on my truck. I was very satisfied with their work. I will use them for all my future mechanic work!

reviews.author: Paul Glover
reviews.text: Romeo is the man. I broke down in Statesville and he helped me out and took me and my car 150 miles to SC. Recommended.

reviews.author: Casey Bolch
reviews.text: Got my dead car hooked up and out of the i-40 construction zone quickly and safely. Very nice and clean tow truck, competent and good driver, very good $ rates.

reviews.author: Spencer B
reviews.text: Girl who answered the phone was great and helpful. Romeo was quick and professional and very nice. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Chris Morse
reviews.text: Awesome people!! Got me in and out extremely fast!! Highly recommend using these guys for all your auto needs.

reviews.author: Debra Stamps
reviews.text: Will never use them again,just as they asked as a great customer...Who does that......(Very Non Professional )

reviews.author: chris Bell
reviews.text: Spent a lot of money and was totally dissappoint 7 days later the very problem I spent all the money on happened again.
